portal_hypertension.title: Differentiating Between Pancreatic Adenosquamous Carcinoma and Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Using Computed Tomography.
portal_hypertension.journal: Canadian Association of Radiologists journal = Journal l'Association canadienne des radiologistes
portal_hypertension.authors: Alkatheeri M, Barat M, Moyne T
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 42）。核心观点：确定有助于区分胰腺腺鳞癌 (PASC) 和胰腺导管腺癌 (PDAC) 的 CT 特征。 临床提示：由 2 名独立读者分析了 42 名 PASC 患者的 CT 检查结果，并与 42 名 PDAC 患者的 CT 检查结果进行了比较。
portal_hypertension.abstract: To identify CT features that may help discriminate between pancreatic adenosquamous carcinoma (PASC) and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). CT examinations of 42 patients with PASC were analyzed by 2 independent readers and compared to those obtained in 42 patients with PDAC. Sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy of each variable for diagnosing PASC versus PDAC were calculated. Associations between variables and PASC were examined using univariable and multivariable analyses. A CT signature was developed to distinguish PASC from PDAC. portal_hypertension.title: Follow-up of jaundice-free biliary atresia survivors using M2BPGi and APRI in a local hospital.
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：在资源有限地区缺乏肝移植（LT）中心的当地医院，重要的是检测具有天然肝脏的无黄疸胆道闭锁（BA）幸存者的肝损伤和门静脉高压的早期预警信号。 临床提示：使用血清 Mac-2 结合蛋白糖基化异构体 (M2BPGi) 和天冬氨酸转氨酶与血小板比率对 6 名 BA 幸存者的 23 份血液样本和评分（Child-Pugh 评分 5 分）进行了评估。
portal_hypertension.abstract: In local hospitals with resource-limited regions lacking access to liver transplantation (LT) centers, it is important to detect early warning signs of liver damage and portal hypertension in jaundice-free biliary atresia (BA) survivors with native livers. Twenty-three blood samples and scorings from six BA survivors (Child-Pugh score 5 points) were evaluated using serum Mac-2 binding protein glycosylation isomer (M2BPGi) and aspartate aminotransferase to platelet ratio index (APRI) at a local hospital.
